name: Wizards
overview: Scripture clearly condemns the practice of wizardry and seeking after familiar spirits as defiling and worthy of judgment, warning that God sets His face against those who turn to such practices and will cut them off from His people. These activities are listed alongside other sinful behaviors that lead to eternal punishment, as seen in Revelation's description of sorcerers' fate in the lake of fire. Believers are called to reject a carnal mindset that embraces occult practices and instead pursue a spiritual mind that leads to life and peace.
